content: bubbletea viewport (bubbles/viewport): Width/Height fields, Style for borders/padding, SetContent(string) with the full rendered content. Scrolling: LineUp/LineDown/HalfViewUp/HalfViewDown/GotoTop/GotoBottom. ScrollPercent() for footer. Key bindings: arrow keys, Page Up/Down, j/k. IMPORTANT: if content exceeds terminal height, renderer breaks — virtual windowing required for large files. For synchronized scroll across two viewports (side-by-side diff), y_offset must be manually kept equal.
